events.watch_url: Prep: Prepped as a junior and senior at IMG Academy in Bradenton, Florida…played for Rig Haga in Norrkoping, Sweden, as a sophomore and played her freshman season at Skolan Costa del Sol in Fuengirola, Spain…helped Unicaja to the 2021 U14 Spanish National Championship, averaging 7.7 points and 6.9 rebounds in the tournament…was a Run 4 Roses standout in 2024…selected to the Andalusian Regional Team and won the 2022 Andalusian Provincial Championship with Malaga…represented Malaga’s Provincial Team in 2021 and 2022…Andalusian Champion with Unicaja in 2022 and 2023…averaged eight points, five rebounds, and 2.5 blocks per game…played for Sweden’s U16 and U18 national team, winning bronze at the 2023 FIBA U16 European Championship Division B…won gold at the 2025 FIBA u18 EuroBasket Division B…selected for Spain’s U14, U15, and U16 national team camps…Spanish U14 National Championship Tournament 1st Place…Spanish U16 National Championship Tournament 3rd place two times…European Championship Division B third place…European Championship Division B 1st place.  Personal: Daughter of Paloma Martinez (mother) and Arne Skog (father)…has two older brothers in Daniel and Jonas…graduated with honors from IMG…favorite color is pink…favorite midnight snack is Lucky Charms…favorite actress is Sofia Vergara…favorite pro team is Real Madrid…states her mom is her hero.
